subject.title: Control UI: composer run-status pill is visually heavy

question: Should the composer run status adopt the running-tool dot and text-wave language, including removal of the bordered chrome on desktop and mobile?
rationale: The report identifies a real inconsistency, but visual hierarchy and animation are product-design choices rather than broken established behavior.

options.title: Unify active-work styling
options.body: Adopt a reduced-motion-safe dot and text wave for active states while retaining accessible static terminal icons and semantic colors.

options.title: Keep distinct status styling
options.body: Retain the current chip and treat composer status as intentionally more prominent than transcript tool activity.

recommendation.title: Unify active-work styling
recommendation.body: Adopt a reduced-motion-safe dot and text wave for active states while retaining accessible static terminal icons and semantic colors.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties both visual treatments to this person's recent commit, making them the strongest routing candidate for the design choice.
